title: Dogfood: capture_baseline.py null measurements lack per-field reasons
detail: capture_baseline.py (HRS-001 deliverable) writes all 10 measurement fields as null with a single global 'notes' string carrying the reason. Fix when the real capture pass lands: each null measurement should be {'value':null,'reason':'pending_implementation'} or equivalent, so downstream consumers (AC-4/AC-8 benchmark reports) can distinguish 'not yet implemented' from 'failed to measure'.
